countConflictStandardApplied: A count conflict is resolved only where the controlling review itself or an adopted authority correction establishes one of six grounds: clerical summary error; a keyed section that is a supporting action; a keyed section that is a local variant; a keyed section that duplicates another; a summary omission of an expressly distinct mechanism; or a body omission of a mechanism named in the summary. Inference from statute numbering is barred. No runtime track IDs were invented.

utCountResult.probableCauseIdentifiedNotAdopted: The document contains exactly sixteen keyed '##' headings. Sixteen is reachable only by counting UT-COMMON and UT-ADJ-01 as petition tracks (UT-PET-01..10 = 10, +UT-COMMON, +UT-ADJ-01 = 12). Counsel expressly disclaims both as tracks, so this is flagged as the most likely CAUSE of the miscount but is NOT adopted as a resolving ground.

groundsTested.a_clerical_error: NOT ESTABLISHED. The review never states, corrects, retracts or qualifies the numeral 'Sixteen'. Nearest evidence is Part 5: 'Every ordinary adult record-clearance mechanism was identified. Confirmed with one exception: UT-PET-10 ... is identified but its current citation is unresolved.' That asserts body completeness but names no number; adopting it would be inference, which the standard forbids.
groundsTested.b_supporting_action: NOT ESTABLISHED as to any of the fourteen. The two express non-mechanisms sit outside the fourteen; excluding them widens rather than closes the gap.
groundsTested.c_local_variant: EXPRESSLY NEGATED. Counsel on UT-PET-09: 'This is a different petition and order from the certificate-of-eligibility track, which is why it is a separate track and not a variant.' Also 'Utah has essentially none. This is a statewide form state.'
groundsTested.d_duplicate: NOT ESTABLISHED. Automatic/petition pairs are stated fallback relationships, not duplicates: 'the same disposition is eligible for automatic expungement 180 days after dismissal. Petitioning is the faster paid route.'
groundsTested.e_summary_omitted: NOT APPLICABLE. This ground would raise the body above the summary; the discrepancy runs the other way.
groundsTested.f_body_omitted: NOT ESTABLISHED. The summary names no mechanism at all - only a bare total and three buckets, with no track name, statute or key - so nothing named can be checked as missing. Statute-numbering inference (Part 2 running 202/204/205/206) is expressly barred.

counselAddendumMustAnswer: Is 'Sixteen' correct as written, or is the correct total fourteen? A direct answer on the numeral.
If sixteen: identify the two petition-based tracks bringing UT-PET-01..10 from ten to twelve, by name, controlling statute and newly assigned key.
If fourteen: confirm the sentence is a clerical error and state the corrected bucket breakdown (expected three automatic, ten petition-based, one appellate).
Confirm whether 'twelve petition-based' was ever intended to include UT-PET-11.
Confirm whether UT-PET-10 was counted in the summary's sixteen notwithstanding its unresolved citation and OUTPUT STRATEGY: unresolved.
Confirm no keyed track was dropped during drafting; the body key sequence UT-PET-01..11 is unbroken.

utCountResult.internalTension: Part 5 certifies 'All unresolved issues are expressly listed. Confirmed' yet the nine listed unresolved questions do not include the count discrepancy.

architectureVerified: SECTION 1 amends section 40-32-101 by deleting language.

SECTION 2 adds NEW sections 40-32-106, 40-32-107, 40-32-108 and 40-32-109. Section 40-32-108 is the petition/procedure section and creates a rebuttable presumption where the petitioner meets 40-32-107(a)(1)(A)-(E).

SECTION 3 amends section 40-32-102 adding the certification provisions, including the carve-out 'if the expungement is pursuant to section 40-32-109 or section 40-32-106, unless...' - CONFIRMS the review's finding that the internal reference states the carve-out backwards and omits section 40-32-109.
SECTION 5 amends section 16-3-810 substituting 40-32-106(f); SECTION 8 amends section 38-6-118(d)(2) substituting section 40-32-107.
enactingLawVerified.materialCorrection: The review states a NEW section 40-32-105 for human trafficking victims sits inside the reorganized chapter. Public Chapter 268 shows section 40-32-105 PRE-EXISTED and was merely amended (SECTION 11 amends 40-32-105(a); SECTION 12 amends 40-32-105(b)(6)(C)(i)). The genuinely new sections created by SECTION 2 are 106, 107, 108 and 109. The review's related open question should be reframed: section 40-32-105 is pre-2025 law, not new-chapter law.

codificationStatus.whyNot: The only publisher of the Tennessee Code is session-gated. No official .gov page anywhere confirms that sections 40-32-105 through 109 are codified in their new numbering.

downstreamAgencyEvidence.finding: TBI's live page cites T.C.A. section 40-32-101 for the expungement process, TCA 40-15-105 for pretrial diversion and TCA 40-35-313 for judicial diversion. It cites NO section in the 105-109 range.
States 'For more information, see T.C.A. section 40-32-101.'

Search index shows the page title 'Updated Expungement Information Coming Soon to Reflect Changes to T.C.A. section 40-32-101', but the page could NOT be retrieved and is therefore NOT marked verified.
downstreamAgencyEvidence.limitation: tncourts.gov serves a JavaScript bot challenge to both channels. WebFetch received 'Please wait while we validate your browser'; a shell fetch with a browser user-agent returned HTTP 200 but only a ~2.4KB JS computational challenge, not page content. The same challenge blocks the expungement PDF handouts.

codificationStatus.netConclusion: More than 15 months after the reorganization took effect on 2025-04-24, the state's own law-enforcement guidance still points users to section 40-32-101. This corroborates and strengthens the review's warning that any Tennessee petition should confirm the citation with the county clerk or DA before filing: official state agency guidance itself has not migrated. It does NOT establish that the Code is uncodified; it establishes only that downstream agency materials are stale.
